public String archiveBackupKeepCount

        The number of archive backups retained for the MySQL instance.

      • archiveBackupKeepPolicy

        @NameInMap(value="ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy")
public String archiveBackupKeepPolicy

        The retention period of archive backups for the MySQL instance.

        example:

        ByMonth

      • archiveBackupRetentionPeriod

        @NameInMap(value="ArchiveBackupRetentionPeriod")
public String archiveBackupRetentionPeriod

        The number of days for which archive backups are retained for the MySQL instance.

        example:

        365

      • backupInterval

        @NameInMap(value="BackupInterval")
public String backupInterval

        The backup interval. Unit: minutes.

        • For MySQL instances: the snapshot backup frequency, not the snapshot backup cycle.
        • For SQL Server instances: the log backup frequency.
        example:

        30

      • backupLog

        @NameInMap(value="BackupLog")
public String backupLog

        Indicates whether log backup is enabled. Valid values:

        • Enable: yes
        • Disabled: no

        For SQL Server instances:

        • Enable is returned only when instance log backup frequency is every 5 minutes.
        • Disabled is returned when instance log backup frequency is every 30 minutes or the same as the data backup frequency. Refer to the value of BackupInterval.
        example:

        Enable

      • backupMethod

        @NameInMap(value="BackupMethod")
public String backupMethod

        The backup method for SQL Server instances with cloud disks. Valid values:

        • Physical: physical backup
        • Snapshot: snapshot backup
        example:

        Physical

      • backupPriority

        @NameInMap(value="BackupPriority")
public Integer backupPriority

        The secondary node backup setting for SQL Server Enterprise Cluster Edition instances. Valid values:

        • 1: Prefer secondary node.
        • 2: Force primary node.

        This parameter is returned only when SupportModifyBackupPriority is True.

        example:

        2

      • backupRetentionPeriod

        @NameInMap(value="BackupRetentionPeriod")
public Integer backupRetentionPeriod

        The number of days for which data backups are retained.

        example:

        7

      • category

        @NameInMap(value="Category")
public String category

        Indicates whether backup within seconds is enabled for MySQL and PostgreSQL instances. Valid values:

        • Flash: enabled
        • Standard: disabled

        This parameter takes effect only when the BackupPolicyMode parameter is set to DataBackupPolicy.

        example:

        Standard

      • compressType

        @NameInMap(value="CompressType")
public String compressType

        The backup compression method. Valid values:

        • 0: no compression
        • 1: zlib compression
        • 2: parallel zlib compression
        • 4: quicklz compression with database and table restoration enabled
        • 8: quicklz compression without database and table restoration supported
        example:

        1

      • enableBackupLog

        @NameInMap(value="EnableBackupLog")
public String enableBackupLog

        Indicates whether log backup is enabled. Valid values:

        • 1: enabled
        • 0: disabled

        For SQL Server instances:

        • 1 is returned only when instance log backup frequency is every 5 minutes.
        • 0 is returned when instance log backup frequency is every 30 minutes or the same as the data backup frequency. Refer to the value of BackupInterval.
        example:

        1

      • enableIncrementDataBackup

        @NameInMap(value="EnableIncrementDataBackup")
public Boolean enableIncrementDataBackup

        Indicates whether incremental backup is enabled for the SQL Server instance. Valid values:

        • True: yes
        • False: no
        example:

        True

      • enablePitrProtection

        @NameInMap(value="EnablePitrProtection")
public Boolean enablePitrProtection

        Indicates whether point-in-time recovery (PITR), an upgraded version of log backup, is enabled for the MySQL instance. Valid values:

        • True: yes
        • False: no

        For more information, see Configure a point-in-time recovery policy.

        example:

        True

      • highSpaceUsageProtection

        @NameInMap(value="HighSpaceUsageProtection")
public String highSpaceUsageProtection

        Indicates whether binary logs are forcibly deleted when the storage usage of the MySQL instance exceeds 80% or the remaining storage is less than 5 GB. Valid values:

        • Disable: no
        • Enable: yes
        example:

        Enable

      • incBackupInterval

        @NameInMap(value="IncBackupInterval")
public Integer incBackupInterval

        The interval for high-frequency incremental backups. Unit: minutes. Valid values: 60, 120, 240, 360, and 720.

        120

      • preferredBackupPeriod

        @NameInMap(value="PreferredBackupPeriod")
public String preferredBackupPeriod

        The data backup cycle. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Valid values:

        • Monday: Monday
        • Tuesday: Tuesday
        • Wednesday: Wednesday
        • Thursday: Thursday
        • Friday: Friday
        • Saturday: Saturday
        • Sunday: Sunday
        example:

        Monday,Wednesday,Friday,Sunday

      • preferredBackupTime

        @NameInMap(value="PreferredNextBackupTime")

        2018-01-19T15:15Z

        @NameInMap(value="ReleasedKeepPolicy")

        None
